breaking.change: Changed from u32 to i32 (-1 for non-cutting inspect hotspots) and added kind, shape, label, and inspected fields.
breaking.fix: Check hotspot.kind === "inspect" (or hotspot.choice < 0) before passing hotspot.choice to og.flow.choose, and route inspect hotspots to og.flow.inspect.

breaking.change: og.timeline now runs before og.video in the same tick, and og.flow persists queued ops, gestures, inspected clues, transcript history, and persistent BGM in its own FlowBlock state block.
breaking.fix: Existing world snapshots taken before this change are incompatible; re-record snapshots and golden hashes.

added.summary: Adjust playback speed (0.25x to 4x) on the active flow segment.
Seek within the active flow segment (0..cut), updating hold and loop state.
Trigger non-cutting inspect hotspots (track hotspot kind "inspect") and emit og.FlowInspected.
Feed deterministic swipe and drag gestures into mobile QTEs; added timing, sequence, swipe, and drag QTE types emitting og.FlowQteResult.
Cross-segment persistent background music (also via og-flow-music header) with smooth crossfade and automatic voice ducking.
Deterministic transcript backlog recording shown captions and chosen options.
Lightweight branch-rewind checkpoint and og.flow.jump direct chapter/node jump with variable restore.
Presentation-only ABR quality selection (auto, high, medium, low) backed by #stream, #stream720, and #stream480 renditions plus og.video.buffering status.
Added WebVTT (.vtt) import, speaker labels, rich inline markup spans, and top/bottom cue positioning.
Added sub-range looping (loopStart/loopEnd on VideoPlayer and Timeline) powering seamless flow.loopStart..flow.loopEnd idle choice loops.
CLI continuity checker comparing outgoing last frames and incoming first frames across cuts, plus cycle/unreachable analysis in og flow routes.

fixed.summary: Stream textures now park at 1x1 (4 bytes) when idle and close idle decoders, preventing VRAM/decoder OOM in long-form interactive films with hundreds of segments.

Web video stream/chunk files are evicted from WASM heap after read, backward seeks cancel stale rav1d worker outputs via a generation counter, failed chunk fetches cap retries, and WebCodecs decode failures propagate and fall back to rav1d-wasm.

Streamed video audio now streams directly from ffmpeg into chunked Opus with bounded memory (replacing gigabyte temp WAV + whole-file QOA) and supports two-pass linear EBU R128 loudness, posterSize scaling, and audioLocale dubbing tracks.

Fixed decks:1 self-loops, og-flow-dissolve audio/caption/picture conflicts, multi-option-group choice indexing, paused start events, Tick-1 texture assignment, footage-to-live 1-frame cut gap, and snapshot/restore determinism.

Fixed pointer-events blocking live 3D scenes, added aspect-accurate videoBox hotspot alignment for landscape and 9:16 portrait viewports, lifted subtitles above open choice bars, and added touch swipe/drag QTE input.
